sql: SELECT year, SUM(actual_all_crimes) tot, SUM(actual_motor_vehicle_theft_total) mvt, SUM(actual_murder) murder, MAX(number_of_months_reported) m FROM crime.cde_reta WHERE ori='TN0190100' AND year IN (2024,2025,2026) AND month<=9 GROUP BY year ORDER BY year

SELECT ori, agency_name, year, SUM(actual_all_crimes) tot, SUM(actual_motor_vehicle_theft_total) mvt, SUM(actual_murder) murder FROM crime.cde_reta WHERE agency_name ILIKE '%NASHVILLE%' AND agency_state_name ILIKE '%TENN%' AND year IN (2024,2025,2026) AND month<=9 GROUP BY ori, agency_name, year ORDER BY ori, year
